name: zam3858/bemykad
description: A PHP package to validate and extract information from Malaysian MyKad numbers.

suggest.laravel/framework: For easy integration with Laravel, use the BeMyKadServiceProvider.
suggest.symfony/symfony: For easy integration with Symfony, use the BeMyKadBundle.
suggest.codeigniter4/framework: The package can be used directly with CodeIgniter 4 due to PSR-4 autoloading.
